messages:
Maya (InfoSec): Heads up — we're deprecating long-lived internal API keys and service account JSON keys. All services must migrate to OIDC short-lived tokens or Workload Identity. Deadline: 2026-04-05 23:59 UTC.
Sam (Platform): What's the enforcement mechanism after the deadline? Any auto-blocking?
Maya (InfoSec): Yes — CI gate + automated denylist + run-time policy will deny requests using banned key types. We'll also trigger an org-wide secret-scan and open tickets for remaining offenders.
Arjun (SRE): I'll kick off the targeted scan tonight and triage results. Will owners get tickets created automatically?
devops-bot: scheduled secret-scan job "shortlived-enforcement-scan" (run: 2026-03-29T02:00Z). Results will be posted to #eng-security and SQC backlog.
Lena (Backend): For GCP services, is there a recommended migration path? We have a handful of services still using SA key files in s3.
Maya (InfoSec): Recommended: Workload Identity Federation -> short-lived tokens via ADC. Migration doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/migrate-sa-keys
Maya (InfoSec): Quick CLI snippet:
```bash
gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create ...
# attach provider, update service account bindings
kubectl set env deploy/myapp OIDC_CLIENT=... 
```
Priya (Infra): If teams need an on-call maintenance window for rotation (rolling restarts), ping infra@redwood and we'll reserve a slot.
Victor (Security Ops): Action items for service owners:
- Inventory any long-lived keys & mark owner
- Add OIDC integration to CI (token refresh <=1h)
- Move secrets into Secrets Manager with rotation
- Close the remediation ticket when CI + smoke tests pass
Lena (Backend): Any backcompat suggestions? We need a short failover for older clients.
Maya (InfoSec): Use the compatibility helper `scripts/rotate-helper.py --dry-run` and add a short-lived fallback: `RETRY_KV=60` for 24h. Don't keep fallback beyond migration window.
Carlos (CTO): This is high priority — escalate any blockers to me directly. We need minimal customer impact.
Sam (Platform): We'll add a CI pre-commit hook to reject files matching `*service-account*.json` starting 2026-04-06. Also preparing a Console one-click rotation workflow (ETA 2 weeks).
Arjun (SRE): Scan results (initial): 27 services with long-lived creds, 5 infra tickets created, 22 owner alerts sent.
Maya (InfoSec): I'll publish a remediation tracker in #eng-security tomorrow AM with a per-service status table.
devops-bot: ticket created: SQC-3421 — "shortlived-creds-remediation". Reporter: secret-scan-bot
Victor (Security Ops): Reminder: rotate GitHub Actions secrets and any self-hosted runner tokens too.
Maya (InfoSec): If you hit failures after rotation, contact security-oncall@redwood.com and include `rotation-debug.log`. :warning:
Lena (Backend): Thanks, team — I'm scheduling work for today.
Maya (InfoSec): Appreciate it. We'll follow up with metrics and enforcement timeline later today. :thumbsup:
